peerGroups.scope: Verified geography, size/style, currency/hedging, and index-weighting policy are required. Catalogue category and ticker/name similarity do not create a peer group.

policies.missingExpectedMonth: Invalidate affected period; do not fill or bridge a missing month.

fullHoldingsReconciliation.cashAndRounding: Must be reported and reconciled before a complete-portfolio score input is accepted. These bounds are provisional until a provider precision audit is complete.

rolling.winRule: Strictly positive paired CAGR gap; exact ties are not wins

scoreQuantizationAndMateriality.reason: Provider precision, licensed-source uncertainty, and complete-holdings coverage have not been audited. Display rounding is not an approved score tie tolerance.

storage.current: Compact per-ticker snapshots in Firestore etf_metrics; raw price history and shared reference series are not stored.
storage.target: Versioned annual chunks in a dedicated history collection or object storage, with an atomic manifest and on-demand chart reads. Keep comparison caches keyed by tickers, window, cutoff, sources, and methodology.
storage.sizing: No licensed source or coherent retention policy is selected. Measure serialized chunks and Firestore read/write cost before enabling history retention; Firestore Standard documents have a 1 MiB maximum.

legacyMigration.legacyValues: Preserve existing values and states. New snapshots add schemaVersion 2, calculationVersion, runId, and typed metricResults. Existing snapshots without those fields remain readable.
legacyMigration.unitMapping: Return, yield, volatility, drawdown, and concentration values use percent; expenseRatio retains provider net/gross label; recoveryTime uses tradingDays; new risk ratios use ratio; comparison return gaps use percentagePoints; spreads use basisPoints.
legacyMigration.provenance: Legacy provider metadata is fetchedUnverified; no historical source date is rewritten as a retrieval date.

retryAndRunPolicy.universeIdentifier: SHA-256 of the stable ordered ticker universe, truncated to 20 hex characters; workflow checks it across batches.
retryAndRunPolicy.publish: A ticker snapshot is saved after its own refresh succeeds. This is not a coherent whole-universe scoring run; cohort/reference failures remain visible and no score is published.
retryAndRunPolicy.providerAuthorizationGate: The API requires server environment variable ETF_YAHOO_AUTOMATION_AUTHORIZED=true. The GitHub workflow requires repository variable ETF_YAHOO_AUTOMATION_AUTHORIZED=true. Both default off; prior snapshots remain readable.
retryAndRunPolicy.workflowFailure: Any failed ticker or incomplete batch fails an enabled scheduled workflow while prior snapshots remain readable.

metricReadiness.dependency: Complete adjusted monthly levels are calculated, but the existing Yahoo source lacks approved automated-use rights and verified adjustment behavior.
